preamble: Spirantization of the voiceless uvular plosive /q/ to the voiceless uvular fricative [χ] keeps the uvular place and turns full closure into frication. In Cuzco Quechua /q/ is spirantized to [χ] in the syllable coda (/ˈʧaqʎa/ [ˈʧaχʎa] 'reed'), while onset /q/ stays a stop.

examples.note: In Cuzco the uvular stop is spirantized only in the syllable coda, unlike Ayacucho where /q/ is [χ] in all positions; onset /q/ stays a stop (ˈqata 'blanket').

sources: Rodríguez Champi, A. (2006). Quechua de Cusco. http://lengamer.org/publicaciones/trabajos/quechua_cusco_afi.pdf
